text:
Alex: Quick intake — new candidate 'kestral-12b-lite' landed from OSS tracker. Need a fast gating pass (quality + quant ops) before we add to the shelf. TL;DR: perf target <= 120ms p50 on g4dn, embedding drift < 2% vs baseline, and Top-1 QA F1 within -1.5 pts.

Maya: @Alex can you drop the model artifacts link and which eval set we should use? also priority tier? :eyes:

Alex: link: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/kestral-12b-lite/v0.1 (read-only). Use `squad-v2` + `redwood-internal-smoke` + `open-bench/longform-5k`. Priority = P2, but iter needs to be done this week for roadmap sync.

Chao: I'll take quant experiments. Plan: run fp16 baseline -> q4_0 and q4_kv with hfllama-quant tool. Quick command: 
```bash
python infra/bench.py --model=artifacts/kestral-12b-lite --dataset=redwood-internal-smoke --mode=latency --batch=1 --device=gpu
python infra/quant_runner.py --model=... --scheme=q4_kv --calib=1000
```
Expect 2-3 runs, ~6h total.

Rachel: I'll own quality evals + regression checks. Will run 3 seeds on SQuAD/longform and compute embedding cosine drift vs `shelf/timeless-13b` baseline. If embedding drift > 2% or QA F1 drops > 1.5, tag as `quality-block`.

Alex: Great. For gating I'm proposing quick thresholds we can auto-check and put into the intake ticket: 
```json
{"latency_p50_ms":"<=120","embedding_cosine_drift_pct":"<=2","qa_f1_drop_pts":"<=1.5","memory_gb":"<=24"}
```
If any fail, route to `eng-ml/triage` and block shelf add.

Chao: minor note — q4_kv gives ~1.9x perf win on our local p4 tests but sometimes adds 0.8 F1 drop. Will capture with per-run artifacts and put diffs in S3.

ci-bot: benchmark-job 2040002250 started by Chao: infra/bench.py --model=kestral-12b-lite --profile=latency

Maya: timeline check — Chao finish quant by EOD tomorrow, Rachel finish quality by tomorrow noon, then quick sync at 11:30am PT? can we do 30m?

Alex: 11:30 PT works. Please post any regression logs to the ticket. If both pass, I'll create a shelf entry with `serve:canary` tag and request a small canary rollout (10qps) on Dedicated for soak.

Rachel: noted. Also adding one more: verify tokenization matches our preproc (we had a `bpe_offset` mismatch last month).

Chao: acknowledged — will include tokenizer check in quant pipeline.

Alex: Thanks — will open the intake ticket with attached checklist and link back here. If anything urgent, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
